title: Coverage layer
desc: Pick a point (click a node on the map or type a name) to compute radio coverage in every direction based on terrain shape and a simplified link budget (ERP, free-space path loss, receiver sensitivity). Still a simplified model - it does not account for diffraction or attenuation from forest or buildings.
terrainMarginDesc: An obstacle must break the line of sight by more than this to stop the ray - absorbs the elevation model's natural noise (30m grid), which would otherwise falsely block coverage at low antenna heights.
erpDesc: Effective radiated power of the transmitter (including antenna gain). Limits range independently of terrain, via free-space path loss and receiver sensitivity, with a 10 dB fade margin.
fetchElevationFailed: Failed to fetch elevation data. Please try again.
